thig5.1:1.1: paṇṇavīsati vassāni yato pabbajitā ahaṃ | accharāsaṃghātamattaṃ pi citass' upasam' ajjhagaṃ. || ||
thig5.1:2.1: aladdhā cetaso santiṃ kāmarāgen' avassutā | bāhā paggayha kandantī vihāraṃ pāvisiṃ ahaṃ. || ||
thig5.1:3.1: sā bhikkhuniṃ upāgacchiṃ yā me saddhāyikā ahu | sā me dhammaṃ adesesi khandhāyatanadhātuyo. || ||
thig5.1:4.1: tassā dhammaṃ suṇitvāna ekamante upāvisiṃ | pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ. || ||
thig5.1:5.1: ceto paricca ñāṇañ ca sotadhātu visodhitā | iddhi pi me sacchikatā patto me āsavakkhayo | cha me 'bhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ. || || aññatarā
